about: What a body touches in the world, for every Mixamo clip. `things` are what a game puts in the world, each a shape with sizes; `cases` are the kinds of interaction the library's clips make, each naming the things it needs, the words of Mixamo's name and description that pick its clips out (a regular expression, case-blind, tried in this order, the first that matches wins), `reads`, the contacts the reader measures the things' sizes by, `family`, the group the catalogue lists it under, and `by`: `grip` for a case whose body hangs from what its hands hold, placed by its hands and never lifted onto a floor. `parts` names the patches of skin `anim.touches.py` measures. `anim.touches.mjs` reads every clip by it.

parts.heel: the underside of the foot behind the toes
parts.palm: the underside of a hand, its lowest skin
parts.grip: the top of a hand, its highest skin: what a lip or a bar is held by from below
parts.knee: the lowest skin of a shin, the knee when kneeling
parts.seat: the lowest skin of the hips and the thighs
parts.head: the head, its middle and its top

ground.about: the level the body walks on

step.about: a raised floor the body gets up onto or down from: a box, a platform, a stair, a crate

sizes.top: its height over the ground the body leaves
sizes.lip: how far ahead of the body's start its near edge stands

drop.about: where a floor ends over a fall: a cliff, a roof's edge, a pool's side

sizes.edge: how far ahead of the body its edge stands
sizes.fall: how far down the floor beyond it is, where the clip falls

obstacle.about: something waist high the body goes over, its hands set on its top: a low wall, a box, a fence, a rail

sizes.top: the height its hands are set on
sizes.at: how far ahead of the body's start the hands are set
sizes.depth: how far along the way the body goes its top may reach with the feet kept over it

wall.about: an upright face the body kicks, leans on, hides behind, climbs or runs along

sizes.face: how far from the body's start the face stands, and which way it faces
sizes.top: the height of its top, where the clip ends on it

ledge.about: the top edge of a wall the hands hold, the wall under it and its top behind

sizes.lip: the lip's height, read where the hands grip it
sizes.face: the wall's face under it, where the feet are braced on it
sizes.top: the height of the floor on top, where the clip stands up on it

bar.about: a line held overhead with nothing under it: a bar, a branch, a pipe, a zip line

sizes.y: its height, read where the hands grip it
sizes.at: where it stands from the body's start

rope.about: a rope or a pole hung from above, gripped up and down its length

sizes.at: where the line stands from the body
sizes.reach: how far up it the hands climb in one lap

ladder.about: rungs between two rails, against a wall

sizes.standoff: how far the rungs stand off the wall

seat.about: something sat on with the feet on the floor: a chair, a bench, a stool, a toilet, a car's or a pilot's seat

sizes.at: where the seat stands from the body's start
sizes.back: how far behind the hips a back may stand, where the body leans furthest back
sizes.arms: how far apart its armrests stand, where the arms rest on them

table.about: a surface at hand height the hands rest on or work at: a desk, a counter, a bar, a machine, a piano's keys

sizes.y: its height, where the palms rest
sizes.at: where its near edge stands from the body

bed.about: a raised surface the body lies on: a bed, an exam table

sizes.y: its height, where the back lies
sizes.at: where it stands from the body

door.about: a door, a cabinet's door, a drawer, a chest's lid: a handle the hand takes and moves along an arc or a line

sizes.handle: where the hand takes it, height and place
sizes.path: the way the hand moves it while it holds it

control.about: something the hand presses, pulls or takes at one spot: a button, a lever, a keypad, a switch, a torch on a wall, a fountain

sizes.at: where the hand takes it, height and place

tool.about: a long tool held in both hands and worked against the ground: a shovel, a scythe, a hose

sizes.strike: where and when it meets the ground

object.about: a loose thing picked up, put down, carried, pushed or pulled: a box, a crate, a bag, fruit, a heavy block

sizes.at: where the hands take it or let it go, height and place
sizes.span: how far apart the hands hold it

ball.about: a ball struck, caught or carried

sizes.at: where the part that strikes or holds it meets it
sizes.by: the part: a foot, a knee, the head, the chest, a hand

vehicle.about: a car, a helicopter, a canoe, a wheelchair, a plane: a seat inside, and for a car a door beside it

sizes.seat: the seat's height and place from the body's start
sizes.door: where the hand takes the door
sizes.wheel: where the hands hold the wheel or the controls

sizes.surface: the height of its surface over the body's middle
sizes.edge: where the pool's edge stands, where the clip ends at it

partner.about: another body: shaken, kissed, carried, held, thrown, struck, an animal petted

sizes.at: where the hands meet the other body
sizes.clip: the partner's own clip, where Mixamo pairs them
